name: pype/framework
description: The pype core: a lightweight, pipeline-first PHP framework.

suggest.ext-openswoole: Run pype as a long-running OpenSwoole server (APP_SERVER=swoole)
suggest.ext-apcu: In-memory cache and rate limit counters (CACHE_DRIVER=apcu, RATE_LIMIT_DRIVER=apcu)
suggest.phpmailer/phpmailer: Send mail over SMTP, sendmail or mail() (MAIL_DRIVER=smtp|sendmail|mail)
suggest.latte/latte: Write views as .latte templates (the View outlet picks the engine from the file extension)
suggest.eftec/bladeone: Write views as .blade.php templates (Blade syntax, no dependencies)
